item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:10 PM 21 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Corcuera), #Albay(CityOfLigao, Oas and Libon) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(SanPascual, Claveria), #Marinduque and #Romblon(Banton) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
